history.rationale: reproducing test FAILS on buggy and PASSES on fixed; numerical probes are disabled (--no-probes), so the test transition is the whole of the evidence

plans.objective:
Build buggy and fixed pandas revisions with the same compiled recipe, pinned to a NumPy era compatible with the 2.2.x-branch backport (numpy<2), then run the developer test test_unit_str on both so it fails on buggy (wrong value from 32-bit fval) and passes on fixed (fval declared double). Only the environment changes; T_dev is untouched.</objective>

actions.step: Rebuild buggy revision as a compiled package (Cython extensions in pandas/_libs/tslib.pyx) with numpy pinned below 2, matching the early-2024 2.2.x backport era.
Rebuild fixed revision with the identical compiled recipe and numpy<2 pin so the comparison is like for like.
Run the developer test on buggy; expect a genuine assertion failure (string-input result differs from integer-input result), not a collection or import error.
Run the same developer test on fixed; expect PASS.
